subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should a global cron delivery destination be snapshotted into newly created jobs, inherited dynamically at each run, or remain an explicit per-job setting?
rationale: Each choice changes recipient stability, upgrade behavior, and whether later config edits can silently reroute scheduled output, so repository policy and security intent are required before implementation.

options.title: Snapshot New Jobs
options.body: Add a validated global default that is copied into newly created jobs, with explicit per-job delivery winning and existing jobs remaining unchanged.

options.title: Resolve At Runtime
options.body: Have jobs without explicit delivery inherit the current global destination on every run, accepting that config changes can reroute existing jobs.

options.title: Keep Explicit Delivery
options.body: Decline the new config surface and instead improve cron creation flows so users visibly choose and persist a destination for each job.

recommendation.title: Snapshot New Jobs
recommendation.body: Add a validated global default that is copied into newly created jobs, with explicit per-job delivery winning and existing jobs remaining unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and issue discussion connect this person most directly to current configuration policy, documentation, and the prior product-triage decision to keep the focused request open.
